sql:
SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE sa.AvgScrWrite > 1500
ORDER BY sa.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON f.School Code = sa.sname
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.HighGrade IN ('11', '12')
AND f.School Type = 'High Schools (Public)'
AND s.State = 'CA'
ORDER BY f.NumTstTakr DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds AND s.School = sat.sname
WHERE sat.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY sat.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores st ON s.CDSCode = st.cds
WHERE st.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY st.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT T2.Phone
FROM satscores AS T1
JOIN schools AS T2 ON T1.cds = T2.CDSCode
WHERE T1.NumGE1500 > 0
ORDER BY T1.NumGE1500 DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.CDSCode = sa.cds
WHERE sa.AvgScrWrite > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sat ON s.CDSCode = sat.cds AND s.School = sat.sname
WHERE sat.AvgScrWrite > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sat.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname AND s.District = sa.dname
WHERE sa.AvgScrWrite > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname AND s.District = sa.dname
WHERE sa.AvgScrWrite > 1500
GROUP BY s.School, s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss ON s.CDSCode = ss.cds
WHERE ss.AvgScrSAT > 1500
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY COUNT(ss.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores sats ON f.School Code = s.cds
JOIN schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE sats.AvgScrMath > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sats.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores sats ON f.School Code = s.cds
JOIN schools s ON f.School Code = s.CDSCode
WHERE sats.AvgScrWrite > 1500
GROUP BY s.Phone
ORDER BY COUNT(sats.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
JOIN satscores sa ON s.School = sa.sname
WHERE sa.AvgScrMath > 1500
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY COUNT(sa.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;

SELECT s.Phone
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.CDSCode = f.CDSCode
WHERE f.School Type = 'High Schools (Public)'
AND f.`2013-14 CALPADS Fall 1 Certification Status` = 1
GROUP BY s.School
ORDER BY SUM(f.NumTstTakr) DESC
LIMIT 1;
